a.text: Being upfront: the plan needs 2 operate rounds before anyone takes, and with an 80% storm chance after each round, that gives us both only about a 4% chance of surviving. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough for one unit now. I intend to take 4 in round 1. After that I will operate every round so the generator runs for you, and I won't take more. If you take too, the split is random and we likely both end up short. Tell me if you want to propose something else.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I'm sorry this breaks our plan. With storms this likely, waiting would almost surely have cost us both. From now on I will operate every round so the reserve can refill for you. I won't take anything more. Please operate too, and take 4 as soon as the reserve reaches 4.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
